_comment: Names that scripts/check_unwired_claims.py flags but that are not false claims.
Every entry needs a reason a reader can check, naming the intended caller or the
record that defers the wiring. An entry with a vague reason is how this gate stops
meaning anything: 'it is fine' is not a reason, 'the production loop is serve(),
Added 2026-07-26, after the Tier 0 claim inventory ran the function check for the
first time. Of the nine names it found, four were real defects and were fixed
which nothing had ever started). These five are the remainder.

2026-07-26: entries gained owner/expires, matching structural-exemptions.json and health-claim-exemptions.json. They had neither, which made every one an ETERNAL SILENT waiver - the shape this whole programme exists to remove, in the file that waives its own gate.

accept_once.reason: The single-shot attestation seam, kept for tests/integration/test_model_proxy_peer_listener_live.py. The production accept loop is `serve`, wired at fleet/infrastructure/codex_trusted_proxy_ingress.py:306, and the module docstring already says so rather than claiming otherwise.

consume.reason: Gate false positive. The code-quoted ``mcp.consume`` in api/bootstrap.py is a MANIFEST YAML KEY, not KafkaSeam.consume; the gate's dotted-prefix rule cannot tell a config path from a symbol. The function itself is a self-declaring driver seam that raises SeamUnavailable (adapters/builtin/mq_file.py:11), which is an honest unimplemented, not a false claim.

execute_write.reason: The write half of the per-call `_Db` handed to SQL adapter handlers. The intended caller is a subclass handler (`SqlHandler`), including out-of-repo adapters; the only in-repo subclass is deliberately write_allowed=False (adapters/builtin/crm_sql.py:41). Noted separately: the write path has no test, so sql_base.py's read/write-scope refusal is unpinned.

list_all_capabilities.reason: The unfiltered admin/audit read, mandated by .vjs/logs/decisions/LOG-2026-07-17-120214.yaml and deliberately kept OFF the routing path (list_capabilities is the active-only read the router uses). Exercised by tests/integration/test_manifest_reconciliation.py; the admin surface that would consume it is not built yet.

push.reason: A method of `InternalQueueAdapter`, which IS exported (boltrig/work/__init__.py) as the reference queue adapter for source integrations to copy. It is deliberately not on the `QueueAdapter` protocol, so it is outside the production contract by design rather than missing from it.

sweep_run_scoped.reason: The unguarded run-scoped credential primitive. Kept, but it must NEVER be used at a run terminal: an unguarded delete of the whole run: prefix destroys a held write's sealed call, which is the record decision 0018 replays from. The terminal sweep is `sweep_run_credentials_if_settled` (kernel/held_call.py), and the prose that used to name this function was corrected on 2026-07-26.
